text: If God is real
Why are there poor people?
God answered that question in a farming rule.
He told farmers.
When you reap the harvest of your land, you are not to reap to the very edges of your field.
Leave the corners.
Leave them for the poor and the foreigner.
so poor people could always find food.
It was built right into the law.
And God said,
Open wide your hand.
Now watch what happened to one poor widow named Ruth.
Her husband had died, she had no money, and she was a foreigner.
She said
Please let me go into the fields and glean heads of grain.
"Glean" means she picked up the leftovers at the corner of a field.
But notice, she just happened to pick a field that belonged to a kind man named Boaz.
Boaz married her, and Ruth became the great-grandmother of King David.
and from David's family came
Jesus.
Jesus came from a woman who picked up leftovers in a field.
Though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor.
And Jesus said,
Whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers of mine.
You did for me.
God's answer to poverty was always people with open hands.
people like you.
